title: Senior Manager - Corporate Audit
description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. Position Summary The Senior Manager, Corporate Audit leads audit projects, develops team members, and partners with business leaders to identify and manage risk. This role helps strengthen internal controls, provides strategic insights, and ensures audits are completed effectively and on schedule. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development Lead, coach, and develop audit team members. Assign work, set priorities, and track project progress. Manage employee performance and career development. Assess staffing needs and team capabilities. Recruit, retain, and develop talent while supporting succession planning. Audit & Risk Management Identify emerging risks and opportunities to improve processes and controls. Ensure audits are completed on time and aligned with the audit plan. Advise business partners on risk management and control effectiveness. Communicate audit progress, findings, and recommendations to stakeholders. Support organizational changes by evaluating impacts to risks and controls. Participate in special projects and strategic initiatives while maintaining audit independence. Audit Execution Oversee audit planning, testing, documentation, reporting, and follow-up activities. Review audit workpapers, testing results, and identified control issues. Ensure audit findings and conclusions are accurate, well-supported, and clearly communicated. Perform audit procedures in accordance with company and professional standards. Partner with business teams and external auditors as needed. Document business processes, testing results, and audit observations. Communication & Stakeholder Management Present audit results, risks, and recommendations to leadership. Build strong relationships with business and audit partners. Help drive corrective actions and issue resolution. Prepare clear and concise written reports and presentations. Department Support Complete administrative responsibilities and support department initiatives. Demonstrate professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to diversity and inclusion. Foster a collaborative and positive team environment. Required Qualifications 7+ years of experience in auditing, accounting, risk management, or a related field. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and business writing skills. Ability to travel up to 10%. Preferred Qualifications CPA, CIA, CISA, or other relevant professional certification (or progress toward certification). Experience leading and developing high-performing teams. Strong knowledge of business processes, risk management, and internal controls. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. Strong presentation and meeting facilitation abilities. Pay Range The typical pay range for this role is: $82,940.00 - $182,549.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. Great benefits for great people We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments . We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/04/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

title: AI Governance Lead

engineering platform and architecture delivery Establish monitoring and reporting: KPIs, compliance tracking, exception handling, escalation paths Run periodic reviews of the governance program's effectiveness and adjust as needed Required Qualifications Combined minimum of 10 years' higher education and/or operational/business analytics/systems development experience Demonstrated experience Risk classification and control design Stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences Program/project management (roadmap building, milestone tracking, prioritization) Working title: Audit Methodology Lead
description: About Fieldguide Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses. We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more. We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. As an early stage start-up employee, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by bringing together up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide. About the Role As an Audit Methodology Lead, you will play a key role in shaping Fieldguide’s methodology integrations. You will act as the bridge between our audit methodology partners and ensuring our agentic platform delivers accurate, contextual, and explainable methodology that auditors can trust and that meets the requirements of audit standards. You will focus on operationalizing methodology documentation and guidance from our partners within the platform. Your role will ensure the methodology and testing agents reflect professional standards, firm guidance, and industry nuances, while continuously learning and improving. You will work closely with product, engineering, and AI teams to ensure our platform translates audit standards, methodology content and professional judgment into reliable AI-powered workflows. This requires a detailed oriented person, solid judgment, and the ability to navigate both standardized and non-standardized content (including professional standards). It’s a great opportunity for someone who is methodical, curious, and interested in learning the inner workings of financial audits. What You’ll Do Methodology Management Define the structure and logic behind Fieldguide's out-of-the-box methodology content with our methodology partners Enable and configure partner-sourced methodology content and audit procedures within the platform, ensuring audit standards are translated into usable, platform-ready workflows Integrate and structure guidance from US GAAS, PCAOB standards, and other relevant frameworks, delivered through partner content into organized, accessible platform content Evaluate and incorporate partner-provided industry procedures, testing approaches, internal control testing, and practice guidance into the platform's methodology library Manage and oversee the methodology content and engagement template ingestion and review process to ensure completeness and accuracy of the methodology content Review and refine methodology and engagement templates incorporating auditor feedback from real-world usage AI Collaboration Partner with AI architects and engineers to translate professional standards and practitioner judgment into prompts, workflows, and guardrails for our integrated methodologies and testing agents Work with product teams to turn audit standards, methodology from our partners and industry guidance into functional specifications and user workflows Implementation & Maintenance Support financial audit implementation teams, including firm-specific customization and annual updates Ensure methodologies and customizations are implemented with appropriate quality control rigor, including version control, review/approval processes, and documentation of changes Monitor regulatory and industry developments and advise on their product implications Maintain and evolve the audit knowledge base as standards and guidance change What We’re Looking For CPA required 5+ years of public accounting experience Strong expertise in AICPA auditing standards (GAAS), PCAOB and audit methodology Experience with audit technology, automation, or AI-enabled tools, audit methodologies, templates, or workpapers. Working knowledge of quality control/quality management standards (e.g., SQMS 1, PCAOB QC standards) as they relate to methodology and audit documentation Ability to translate professional standards into structured workflows and logic Strong analytical thinking and ability to work cross-functionally with product and engineering teams Interest in the intersection of audit, data, and AI Nice to Have Interest in contributing to process improvement and optimization. Experience working in audit methodology or national office roles Expertise in international auditing standards and methodologies Exposure to LLMs, prompt design, or AI-assisted workflows

title: ETF and 1940 Act Registered Funds Compliance Officer - Assistant Vice President

title: Order to Cash Track Lead, Finance Engineering
description: At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers  to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny. At Klaviyo, we know that building a great company starts with building a great team. We welcome candidates from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we care as much about your trajectory and potential as we do about direct, one‑to‑one matches with every requirement. About the team Klaviyo went public in 2023 and is scaling fast. This is a rare chance to lead and build the Order to Cash (O2C) foundation for a company at this inflection point. The Finance Technology Systems team is part of G&A Systems within Global Technology Solutions (GTS). This group designs, operates, and continually improves the applications and workflows that power how Klaviyo manages money, risk, and financial reporting at scale. The team partners closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Procurement, and Internal Audit, as well as adjacent technology teams like Corporate IT, Data, and GTM Systems, to ensure our back‑office stack is reliable, well‑integrated, compliant, and ready for a public, AI‑forward SaaS business. We own the roadmap, health, and governance of platforms including our ERP and financial systems (e.g., NetSuite/Oracle), procure‑to‑pay (e.g., Coupa), revenue and billing systems, and related integrations and automation. This role reports to the Director, G&A Systems and leads the team responsible for Finance Technology Solutions across Klaviyo. What You'll Do As the Order to Cash (O2C) Lead, Finance Systems, you will be the accountable technology leader for Klaviyo’s O2C application landscape and core financial workflows. You will lead Enterprise and International Expansion capabilities that will provide revenue uplift for Klaviyo. Own the O2C track Execute on the roadmap for Klaviyo’s O2C stack aligned to the company priorities by translating business requirements into functional and technical design. Bring first principles thinking to your design. Integrate CPQ to NetSuite and ensure that all Enterprise capabilities are delivered with scale. Look at O2C systems landscape and provide recommendations to set Klaviyo for the future Ensure we deliver with the highest code quality by thoroughly thinking through test cases and applying rigorous build and test. Own SOX, controls, and audit readiness for Finance systems Own the design, implementation, and operation of IT General Controls (ITGCs) and other key controls across O2C applications, in partnership with Internal Audit, Security, and external auditors. Continually simplify and automate controls and evidence collection so audits are reliable and predictable, with fewer deficiencies and lower friction for Finance and GTS teams. Drive AI-native transformation across Finance  Lead Klaviyo's push to make Finance one of the most automated, insight-driven functions in the company. You'll identify and deliver high-value AI use cases across the O2C workflow.  You'll partner directly with Klaviyo's AI and data platform teams and Finance Engineering  to embed AI into core Finance processes with clear guardrails, measurable productivity gains, and the rigor expected of a public company. This isn't a future-state vision, it's work already underway, and you'll own it from a Product standpoint. Design and optimize core Finance processes and systems Have a leader mindset and partner with Controllership, Tax, Treasury  leaders to improve and continuously refine end‑to‑end O2C workflows ensuring systems and processes are tightly aligned. Ensure our ERP and other SaaS O2C applications are configured, integrated, and operated to support accurate, timely close, scalable revenue and billing, and high‑quality financial data that downstream teams can trust. Act as a strategic partner and communicator Serve as the primary technology partner for Controller, and Finance leadership team on systems, data, and process topics;  As needed, represent Finance Technology Systems in executive forums, planning cycles, and cross‑functional initiatives, ensuring O2C needs are anticipated and built into wider GTS and company roadmaps. Who You Are You've spent your career at the intersection of Finance and Technology and you've moved beyond just keeping systems running. You think in product design, roadmaps, outcomes, and partnerships. You know what a well-run O2C  function looks like, and you know how to build one. You've worked in  teams through real complexity: ERP and other transformations, SOX audits, billing

title: Director of General Ledger Accounting
description: ABOUT US: Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI. About the Role We are seeking a Director of General Ledger Accounting to lead the general ledger function and own the month-end close process. This role will ensure accurate, timely financial results, oversee accounting processes within NetSuite, and coordinate across all accounting workstreams to deliver a complete and well-controlled close. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting knowledge, hands-on NetSuite experience, and the ability to lead teams, resolve complex issues, and improve processes as the business grows. Key Responsibilities - Own the month-end close: Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual GL close activities, including the close calendar, deliverables, dependencies, review procedures, and issue resolution. - Oversee general ledger integrity: Review journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules. Ensure balances are accurate, supported, and recorded in the appropriate period. - Coordinate all accounting workstreams: Partner with accounts payable, revenue and accounts receivable, payroll, equity, fixed assets, leases, intercompany, treasury, and tax teams to ensure timely inputs, clear ownership, and consistent accounting treatment. - Lead NetSuite accounting processes: Serve as the accounting lead for NetSuite, partnering with systems teams on workflows, chart of accounts governance, reporting, integrations, and system enhancements. Oversee period-close procedures and controls over GL data. - Review financial results: Lead balance sheet and income statement fluctuation reviews, investigate unusual activity, and communicate key drivers and unresolved issues to accounting leadership and FP&A. - Strengthen controls and documentation: Establish and maintain accounting policies, close procedures, reconciliation standards, and review controls. Drive timely resolution of reconciling items and control deficiencies. - Support financial reporting and audits: Deliver accurate trial balances and supporting schedules, coordinate audit requests across accounting workstreams, and resolve audit findings. - Improve efficiency and scalability: Identify opportunities to automate journal entries, reconciliations, and reporting; reduce manual work; and shorten the close while maintaining accuracy. - Develop the team: Lead and coach the GL accounting team, set clear expectations, balance workloads, and build accountability for quality and deadlines. - Support business changes: Assess the GL and close implications of new entities, transactions, systems, and business initiatives, coordinating implementation across relevant teams. Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA preferred.. - 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 4+ years managing teams and leading the financial close. - Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, general ledger accounting, reconciliations, and internal controls. - Hands-on NetSuite experience, including close management, financial reporting, and accounting process improvements. - Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple accounting workstreams, manage dependencies, and resolve issues under tight deadlines. - Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to explain accounting issues clearly to finance and business partners. - Experience with multi-entity accounting, intercompany transactions, and consolidation preferred. What Success Looks Like A predictable, timely close; accurate and well-supported GL balances; clear accountability across accounting workstreams; effective use of NetSuite; and a team that continually improves the quality and efficiency of financial reporting. WHY FIREWORKS? - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving. - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally. - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results. - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation. Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.
